ei.title: Chapter 6-18 1번: Lincoln's Forgiveness and Great Character
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: As a young, struggling lawyer, Abraham Lincoln felt honored to be employed on an important legal case. The other lawyers chosen to represent the case were well known for their legal and persuasive expertise. However, one lawyer, upon seeing Lincoln, remarked, "What is that tall idiot doing here? I refuse to work with him. Get rid of him." Lincoln remained calm and pretended not to hear the deliberate insult. As the trial proceeded, Lincoln was ostracized by the other lawyers. In fact, he was never recognized as one of the representing lawyers. He listened carefully to the court proceedings and observed his insulter's masterful handling of the case. The lawyer who insulted Lincoln easily won the case. The next day, Lincoln was quoted as saying, "His brilliant argument was a revelation to me. He was expertly prepared, fluent in his presentation, and demonstrated undoubtedly the most professional questioning I have ever witnessed. I'm nowhere near as talented as he is. I am going home to study law all over again." Years later, Abraham Lincoln became president of the United States. That same lawyer who had rudely insulted Lincoln became his most outspoken critic. However, Lincoln never forgot the brilliance of this man. When an appointment was needed for secretary of war, Lincoln chose Edwin M. Stanton, the very man who had wounded and insulted him. Lincoln proved his character by offering a forgiving spirit rather than a lifetime grudge. Shortly thereafter, Lincoln was shot and killed. Stanton, filled with sorrow and grief, sobbed, "Now he belongs to the ages!"

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① honored(영광으로 여기는)+persuasive(설득력 있는)+calm(침착한): 링컨이 소송에 고용된 것을 '영광'으로 여겼고, 다른 변호사들이 '설득력' 있는 전문성으로 유명했으며, 모욕을 듣고도 '침착함'을 유지했다는 문맥에 모두 맞음 ← 정답
❌ ② ashamed(부끄러운)는 '영광으로 여겼다'는 흐름과 반대
❌ ③ confusing(혼란스러운)은 '설득력 있는 전문성'과 어울리지 않음
❌ ④ anxious(불안한)는 '침착함을 유지했다'는 흐름과 반대
det.tip: honored=영광으로 여기는, persuasive=설득력 있는, calm=침착한
